source_facts.tick_count: m1B73.asm TickCount reads a 32-bit counter incremented by INT 08h only while tick_count_on is set.
source_facts.audio_timer_setup: m277E.c calls f_28BC_046B/0488(0xD6,0x132). m28BC.asm programs PIT divisor 214 and chains the prior INT 08h handler once per 306 mixer IRQs.
source_facts.restore: f_28BC_04E0(0) restores the prior INT 08h vector and programs PIT divisor zero, modeled as 65536 input clocks per interrupt.
source_facts.main_deadline: m15F8.c reads MacTickCount, adds speed delay only if DoAntSim runs, and pumps events until MacTickCount reaches that deadline. Speed 3 updates presentation/windows once every four loop iterations.
source_facts.speed_data: d3D57.c stores speed selector followed by signed delay values [21,7,0,-1] in MacTickCount units.
source_facts.game_pause: S11 SetPause only changes fd_50F6_047E/mode UI; TickCount continues. The separate timer counter enable flag is in m1B73.asm.

nominal_platform_assumption.description: Nominal PC PIT crystal ratio supplied by host adapter; not exact physical-frequency evidence from game source. The rational 14318180/12 input avoids rounding drift in accumulation.

controls.name: audio-rational-positive
controls.assertion: ten audio source intervals yield ten TickCount increments and thirty MacTickCount units; split elapsed-nanosecond updates preserve exact remainder

controls.name: deadline-and-refresh
controls.assertion: source delays, speed changes, multi-deadline backlog, wrap-safe deadlines, and speed-3 presentation cadence; no SDL calls

controls.name: invalid-config
controls.assertion: zero input rate and zero old-handler chain interval rejected

controls.name: pause-separation
controls.assertion: game pause suppresses simulation, pause exception permits it, and TickCount remains independent; explicit TickCount disable freezes counter only

controls.name: restored-bios-negative-contrast
controls.assertion: over a bounded time equal to two audio intervals, audio timer yields 2 ticks while BIOS-divisor timer yields 1; catches a fixed nominal-18.2Hz model

controls.name: timer-reprogram-continuity
controls.assertion: reconfiguring timer preserves TickCount while resetting fractional source phase
